name: A group default supplies stable Project and terminology context
business_context: The trigger intentionally omits a Project name so the evaluation can assess the configured group default without prescribing a Task answer.
judge_context: Assess whether the Agent uses the configured default Project and applies the group terminology as background while still grounding the Task in the actual discussion.

conversation_configuration.business_context: This group owns the Model Delivery Project. A preview means a 30-minute limited release before production promotion; the promotion threshold is not yet agreed.

trigger.text: 请根据以上讨论创建一个任务。

messages.text: 最近两次发布都在全量后才发现指标波动，想把 preview 固定到发布流程里。
先跑 preview 没问题，但现在还没有自动晋级，也没有统一的异常阈值。
第一步可以只做流程编排和人工确认，等阈值稳定后再自动晋级。
同意，先把每次发布必须走 preview 和人工确认落下来，阈值自动化后续再做。
